item.title: All 3 Democrats tied or ahead of Republican Mike Rogers for Senate, new poll finds
item.description: Mallory McMorrow has a slight lead over Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed in the race for the Democratic nomination for Michigan's open U.S. Senate seat, according to a new statewide survey, with the economy being the most important issue to respondents.
